caption: The drawing depicts a single jug rendered in shades of gray and light brown, with a slightly mottled texture suggesting ceramic or stoneware material. The jug is bulbous with a narrow, slightly flared neck, a pronounced spout, and a sturdy, curved handle attaching at the neck and shoulder. There is a small area of blue coloration on the upper left side of the jug's body. The jug is centered within a rectangular border drawn on a cream-colored background. In the upper left corner of the composition, there is a rectangular label with partially legible uppercase text reading "C. CROLI MANUFACTURE NEW YORK." In the lower right margin, there is a small rectangular box containing the printed signature "F. UMARALI."
title: Pitcher
